stories.title: India–EU Free Trade Agreement concluded
stories.body: described as the "Mother of All Deals" at the 16th India–EU Summit (Jan 27, 2026); India's first-ever Defence & Security Partnership with the EU also signed, opening the EU's SAFE defence financing to Indian companies.

one_liners: India–EU Free Trade Agreement concluded — described as the "Mother of All Deals" at the 16th India–EU Summit (Jan 27, 2026)
